prerequisites.title: Admin access to a ServiceNow instance
prerequisites.detail: Managing OAuth needs the security_admin role. OIDC entity setup needs oauth_admin.

prerequisites.title: Build Partner status
prerequisites.detail: Required before you can list on the ServiceNow Store.

prerequisites.title: Own OAuth client ID and secret
prerequisites.detail: Composio needs your client ID and secret because it has no managed ServiceNow app.

steps.title: Register OAuth client in Application Registry
steps.detail: On the instance, go to System OAuth > Application Registry and create the client. The instance generates the client ID, and the secret can be auto-generated.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Define OAuth scopes
steps.detail: Draft the scope list and the OAuth Entity Scopes entries. Scopes agents need were not listed in the docs.
steps.done_when: Scopes are defined and selectable in a profile.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into your ServiceNow client.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and redirect URI matches.

steps.title: Connect an account and test
steps.detail: A user must authenticate once to fetch the token. Then confirm refresh behavior.
steps.done_when: A connected account makes a successful call.

steps.title: Prepare certification documents
steps.detail: Draft the design document, test plan and customer installation guide. Prepare listing marketing copy and a demo video script.

steps.title: Apply, submit and record demo
steps.detail: Join as a Build Partner, record the demo videos and submit the app and listing.

steps.title: Certification and listing review
steps.detail: The certification team inspects the app and the listing. No timeline was found.

traps.title: Self-signed certificates are rejected
traps.detail: The OAuth client will not connect to endpoints with a self-signed certificate.

traps.title: Tokens expire and need handling
traps.detail: Instance-issued access tokens last 30 minutes and refresh tokens 100 days by default. Third-party tokens last 30 days and 365 days. The inbound JWT grant issues no refresh tokens.

traps.title: Managed Composio app is not an option
traps.detail: Do not plan on a prototype shortcut. You need your own client from the start.

blockers.symptom: Cannot see System OAuth or Application Registry
blockers.what_it_means: Your account lacks the required admin role.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the instance admin for security_admin or oauth_admin.

blockers.symptom: Cannot submit to the ServiceNow Store
blockers.what_it_means: Build Partner status is required first.
blockers.what_to_do: Apply to the ServiceNow Partner Program.
